risks.description: No heat treatment, case depth, or hardness is specified. The ring is quoted soft through packing. If carburising is in scope, this route and this price do not include it.
risks.mitigation: Confirm whether heat treatment is in scope. If it is, add carburise, quench and temper plus the post-HT finishing the hardened sizes require.

feasibility.assessment_notes: Bought-in forged ring, finished height 53.8 mm, net 2.8103 kg, quoted soft. Route is incoming inspection, two CNC turning setups, a blank gate, internal shaping in rough and finish passes, chamfer-deburr, gear inspection, wash, final inspection, marking, and rust-preventive pack. No heat treatment is specified, so none is routed. Internal shaving is not used at Ra 3.2. No hole or slot pattern is extracted, so there is no VMC.
